home.title: Read the chart, size the trade, then stress-test it.
home.intro: Each lesson builds a trade on a simulated EUR/USD chart, one step at a time. Then a news spike, a weekend gap or a wider spread hits it, and you see exactly what happens to your account.
notice: For learning only, not financial advice. Prices are simulated. Leveraged trading can lose money fast, and most retail traders lose.
